preprocessing.expression_provenance: Supplied h5ad values; no raw layer or preprocessing metadata
preprocessing.tokenization: nonzero genes only; prepend CLS; official per-cell quantile binning; random overlength sampling; dynamic padding
preprocessing.pooling: raw CLS features into official cls_decoder; no L2 normalization
preprocessing.prediction_genes: require every saved training gene; reorder to training gene order; ignore additional genes

unknown_policy: retain all predictions; evaluate known ground-truth labels only; no unknown-class detector
